title: 2009 Dakar Rally
who: Won by Giniel de Villiers / Dirk von Zitzewitz (Volkswagen) and Marc Coma (KTM)
summary: The 2009 edition of the Dakar Rally, in its South America era: 13 stage towns and bivouacs through Argentina, Chile. Winners — Cars: Giniel de Villiers / Dirk von Zitzewitz (Volkswagen); Bikes: Marc Coma (KTM); Quads: Josef Macháček (Yamaha); Trucks: Firdaus Kabirov / Aydar Belyaev / Andrey Mokeev (Kamaz).
approximate: Stage towns and bivouacs from Wikipedia's stage table. The rally ran off-road between them, so the lines are straight from bivouac to bivouac.
